calls.statement:
WITH sold AS (
  SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.sale_date, f.quantity, f.net_amount, f.staff_purchase_flag, f.channel_code, f.etl_loaded_at
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
  WHERE s.store_id = 108 AND cp.subcategory = 'Interior Paint' AND cp.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 3
), ret AS (
  SELECT r.return_line_id, r.quantity_returned
  FROM fact_return_line r
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
  JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.return_date
  WHERE s.store_id = 108 AND cp.subcategory = 'Interior Paint'
    AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 3
)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM sold) lines, (SELECT count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) FROM sold) dist_lines,
 (SELECT sum(quantity) FROM sold) units_sold, (SELECT sum(quantity) FROM sold WHERE staff_purchase_flag) staff_units,
 (SELECT sum(quantity) FROM sold WHERE quantity<=0) nonpos, (SELECT min(sale_date) FROM sold) mind, (SELECT max(sale_date) FROM sold) maxd,
 (SELECT count(DISTINCT channel_code) FROM sold) chans, (SELECT sum(quantity_returned) FROM ret) units_returned,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM ret) ret_lines, (SELECT count(*) - count(DISTINCT return_line_id) FROM ret) ret_dups
